verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's core design is a self-hosted gateway that connects messaging channels to the assistant, and its docs list Discord, iMessage, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp and more. WhatsApp and Telegram have dedicated pages marked production-ready, and Discord (DMs and guild channels) and iMessage (replies, tapbacks, attachments, groups) have their own channel docs too. The GitHub tagline "in your chats" and the llms.txt probe back up this positioning. Missing for 10: a dedicated Slack channel page (Slack appears only in the overview list), and independent or hands-on confirmation of the messenger integrations.
